mod.name: Advanced Geology
mod.text:
Rock textures mostly by Viceroy.

This mod completely overhauls ore generation with 40+ new ore deposit types, dozens of new gems, dozens of new ores and minerals, and about a dozen new rocks.

Deposits can be found through a similar process as vanilla density mode prospecting, as well as surface indicators such as nuggets and gossan smears. Unlike vanilla, it is also possible for many deposits to generate high up enough to appear in the sides of cliffs or mountains.

Other deposit types:

Advanced Salt Dome: Custom version of the vanilla salt dome generator that has slightly different spawning rules, generates layers of limestone, gypsum and sulfur based on the climate it spawned in, and is actually dome-shaped.
Laterite Surface Deposit: Custom generator that is similar to the vanilla clay deposits, except with support for layers of different blocks and even depositing ores in the layers of rock immediately underneath the soil. Current deposits are kaolinite and garnierite laterites. The kaolinite deposit spawns anywhere with a decent amount of rain, and the garnierite surface deposit spawns in hot and wet climates. Both deposits have vanilla-style JSON configurations, so if you want to use the generators in your own mod, you can.

Compatibility

2.0.0+ is not compatible with any geology mods that add new stuff.

All gems continue to be fully integrated with CAN Jewelry

Rock Strata Variety:

Compatible and highly recommended whenever you have mods that add more types of rocks.

releases.changelog:
2.0.1

Fixes:

Fix new nickel ores not being smeltable in vanilla.

2.0.0

Tweaks:

Rewrite of ore vein height logic to be terrain-relative instead of sea-level relative.
Adjustments to some ore deposit spawn chances.
Surface deposits and surface nuggets are now far more common in favorable rock zones (so basically not solid granite areas).
Now works with any terrain gen mod where previously it might have had issues with mods that produced large amounts of terrain well above sea level.

Features:

Adds the new generic byproducts system which replaces the old silver grade with a system that supports a wide variety of deposit and mineral specific byproducts. No relevance to vanilla for now.

2.0.0-dev.5

Tweaks:

Major tweaks to ore generation frequency, positioning, and validity. Ore deposits are more likely to spawn near the surface or high up in terrain. Ore deposits are much more frequent in vanilla generation that spawns thin sedimentary layers, and generate more of themselves. 
The prospecting signal radius of ore deposits is increased by 4x.

Fixes:

Fixed issues with gossan and clay generation in surface deposits.
Fixed some surface bits giving ore chunks instead of ore nuggets.

2.0.0-dev.4

Improvements:

Added 3 new config options (create a dummy world to generate the config):

  1. 'IHateGems': default false - Prevents all additional gems from spawning in the world (the gem items are still registered to avoid problems).
  2. 'VanillaOresOnly': default false - Disables all deposits without a major vanilla-relevant ore, including kaolinite.
  3. 'GlobalMineralAbundance': default 1.0 - multiplier on the abundance of deposits. 2.0 means deposits spawn twice as often, etc.

 

Kaolinite and garnierite surface deposits can now spawn in lenses of up to 3 thick instead of only 1 thick.

2.0.0-dev.3 Update

Hotfix patch

hotfix prospecting system issues with hydrate or diedrate
fix surface deposits having their top blocks overwritten by forest floor
fix halite not spawning
removed certain debug messages from the standard console stream

2.0.0-dev.2 Update

This update adds a custom prospecting system that nullifies the need for mods such as betterer prospecting. The prospecting system produces highly warped ore signal fields in the rough vicinity of actual deposits, so it behaves sort of like vanilla prospecting without producing false positives.

2.0.0-dev.1 Update

Do not update existing worlds to this version

 

This update adds almost three dozen unique deposit generators based on real-life major ore deposits, and associated minerals and ores.

Each deposit generates either deep (very deep underground), shallow (stradding sea level), or high (at or above sea level). There are also some surface-hugging generators.

Most base metals will create nuggets above deposits assuming the ore block is less than 31 blocks below the surface. Many deposits will also have a weathering/supergene succession that creates gossan smears at the surface.

The vanilla prospecting system does NOT work, for now. I have an idea of how to hijack it or otherwise introduce prospecting mechanics. Betterer prospecting can work as a stopgap if you desperately need to find a deep deposit.

This update entirely drops compat with all other geology mods, including IOG. 

Refer to the main description for details because for some reason there is a draconian size cap on changelogs
Fix geoaddons compat.
